description: This source file defines the ArgUtils class, a utility class providing static methods for manipulating and transforming argument data structures, specifically for flattening multidimensional Object arrays into a single list.

classes.name: ArgUtils
classes.description: Utility class containing only static methods for argument manipulation, including array flattening.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Transforms a possibly multidimensional Object array into a one-dimensional Object array by recursively traversing nested arrays.
